d20.text: Julia's worm bin. Vermicompost, made at home.

p12.text: Before you bag those leaves, read this.
Leaf litter is rich in carbon and lignin.
Fungi are the main decomposers of lignin.
That feeds the fungal soils trees and shrubs prefer.
A layer of leaves shields the soil over winter.
On a lawn, shred the leaves and move them onto your beds.

p24.text: 440,000,000,000,000,000,000 soil nematodes on Earth, by the 2019 estimate in Nature.
Most feed on bacteria and fungi, and release nitrogen right at the root.
